clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's worry over money and pulling back from talking with your father about it, your brother's grades falling, and then your mother calmer once back at work by early 1990. The shifts in your parents' distance and your brother's functioning sit near the death of a man central to the household.

clusters.name: Your mother's breast cancer diagnosis, 1993–1996
clusters.reason: Around your leaving home for college in September 1993 and your mother's cancer diagnosis in early 1995, within these years: your migraines began and you called your brother most nights, then pulled back from him and stopped calling home. Your symptoms rose, your closeness to your brother turned to distance, and you moved away from your mother as she faced her illness. Every shift in these years is yours, and no one else's shows then.
